trans-unit.id: If you deny these connections, the app will not send crash reports to the developer. Crash reporting is handled by Sentry (sentry.io).

trans-unit.id: If you deny these connections, you will not be able to purchase or activate a Pro license. Licensing is managed by Paddle (paddle.com).

trans-unit.id: If you deny these connections, you will not be notified about new versions and will not be able to update to newer app versions using the app's UI.

trans-unit.target: Si denegueu aquestes connexions, no rebreu notificacions sobre versions noves ni podreu actualitzar l’app a versions més recents des de la seva interfície.

trans-unit.id: You may create network based custom controls (for example to control a network-enabled device like a smart TV, amplifier) in the app that can connect to any hosts you specify on your local network or over the Internet. If you deny these connections, these custom controls will not work.
trans-unit.source: You may create network based custom controls (for example to control a network-enabled device like a smart TV, amplifier) in the app that can connect to any hosts you specify on your local network or over the Internet. If you deny these connections, these custom controls will not work.
trans-unit.target: Podeu crear controls personalitzats basats en xarxa a l’app (per exemple, per controlar un dispositiu connectat a la xarxa, com ara un televisor o un amplificador) que es poden connectar a qualsevol amfitrió que especifiqueu a la xarxa local o a través d’Internet. Si denegueu aquestes connexions, aquests controls personalitzats no funcionaran.

%@ s’ha de reiniciar per aplicar els ajustos importats.

Utilitzeu la funció «Transfereix els ajustos de pantalla» als ajustos addicionals de cada pantalla afectada per corregir la discrepància entre identificadors.

trans-unit.id:
**%@ License Issue Detected**
This installation has been remotely deactivated, or the hardware identifiers have changed since the last license activation. This may have occurred due to a hardware upgrade or migration to a new device.

trans-unit.source:
**%@ License Issue Detected**
This installation has been remotely deactivated, or the hardware identifiers have changed since the last license activation. This may have occurred due to a hardware upgrade or migration to a new device.
Please reactivate this installation to continue using Pro features.
trans-unit.target:
**S’ha detectat un problema amb la llicència de %@**

This license no longer covers the current app version (v%@). To use this version of %@, please purchase a new license.
Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

**%1$@ Outdated License**

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.
trans-unit.target:
**Llicència de %1$@ obsoleta**
La llicència proporcionada es va emetre originalment per a una versió anterior de %2$@ i ja s’ha ampliat una vegada amb una actualització gratuïta a una versió principal posterior.
Aquesta llicència ja no cobreix la versió actual de l’app (v%3$@). Per utilitzar aquesta versió de %4$@, compreu una llicència nova.
Gràcies per la vostra comprensió i pel vostre suport continuat.

Clearing NVRAM also removes low-level firmware preferences, such as startup disk and boot-related settings. macOS will recreate or reset them as appropriate after restart.
trans-unit.source:
Are you sure you want the app to reset macOS display settings? The system will reboot after the reset.
Clearing NVRAM also removes low-level firmware preferences, such as startup disk and boot-related settings. macOS will recreate or reset them as appropriate after restart.
trans-unit.target:
Segur que voleu que l’app restableixi els ajustos de pantalla del macOS? El sistema es reiniciarà després del restabliment.
Esborrar la NVRAM també elimina preferències de baix nivell del firmware, com ara el disc d’arrencada i els ajustos relacionats amb l’arrencada. El macOS les tornarà a crear o restablir segons calgui després del reinici.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Confirmation text shown before resetting macOS display settings. trans-unit.id: The app will apply the loaded EDID when this display is connected. The operation causes the screen to flicker and switch modes if the existing mode is not available with the updated EDID. If the new EDID has different id data (vendor, model, serial), the display will be redetected as a different one. Hold ⇧ Shift on startup to enable safe mode and avoid auto-apply. Physically reconnect display to revert back to the original in case of serious trouble.
trans-unit.source: The app will apply the loaded EDID when this display is connected. The operation causes the screen to flicker and switch modes if the existing mode is not available with the updated EDID. If the new EDID has different id data (vendor, model, serial), the display will be redetected as a different one. Hold ⇧ Shift on startup to enable safe mode and avoid auto-apply. Physically reconnect display to revert back to the original in case of serious trouble.
trans-unit.target: L’app aplicarà l’EDID carregat quan es connecti aquesta pantalla. L’operació fa que la pantalla parpellegi i canviï de mode si el mode existent no està disponible amb l’EDID actualitzat. Si el nou EDID té dades d’identificació diferents (fabricant, model o número de sèrie), la pantalla es tornarà a detectar com una de diferent. Manteniu premuda ⇧ Majúscules en iniciar per activar el mode segur i evitar l’aplicació automàtica. Si hi ha problemes greus, reconnecteu físicament la pantalla per tornar a l’original.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Automatic EDID application safety and recovery help.

Aquesta funció està sempre activa quan l’ampliació de brillantor per programari està activada i els ajustos de la taula de colors no estan disponibles.

trans-unit.id: This allows advanced dimming, color adjustments and other features like software XDR/HDR upscaling. Note: color adjustments clip HDR content when in active use. If this option is disabled, the app will fall back to overlay based dimming control and uses Metal for software XDR/HDR upscaling.
trans-unit.source: This allows advanced dimming, color adjustments and other features like software XDR/HDR upscaling. Note: color adjustments clip HDR content when in active use. If this option is disabled, the app will fall back to overlay based dimming control and uses Metal for software XDR/HDR upscaling.
trans-unit.target: Permet l’atenuació avançada, els ajustos de color i altres funcions com l’ampliació XDR/HDR per programari. Nota: els ajustos de color retallen el rang del contingut HDR mentre s’utilitzen. Si es desactiva aquesta opció, l’app utilitza el control d’atenuació per superposició i Metal per a l’ampliació XDR/HDR per programari.

trans-unit.id: This can be a result of disabled DDC/CI support (check the display's OSD), display firmware limitations or connection issues. Many TVs and TV-derived smart monitors do not support DDC. If the issue cannot be resolved either by changing display settings or fixing cable issues, you should disable DDC support.
trans-unit.source: This can be a result of disabled DDC/CI support (check the display's OSD), display firmware limitations or connection issues. Many TVs and TV-derived smart monitors do not support DDC. If the issue cannot be resolved either by changing display settings or fixing cable issues, you should disable DDC support.
trans-unit.target: Això pot ser degut a la desactivació de DDC/CI (comproveu l’OSD de la pantalla), a limitacions del firmware de la pantalla o a problemes de connexió. Molts televisors i monitors intel·ligents derivats de televisors no admeten DDC. Si el problema no es resol canviant els ajustos de la pantalla o corregint problemes de cable, hauríeu de desactivar la compatibilitat amb DDC.

trans-unit.id: This configures how the data associated with the currently configured display is matched to a detected display during the configuration/detection process. Changing this setting might cause a display to be recognized as previously unconnected and disassociate existing saved display configuration data. System UUID match uses the macOS default identification. When set to use basic identifiers, the app identifies the display by its vendor/model IDs and serial number. With extended it also uses product name, alphanumeric serial number, and production date. With port and location the app also considers hardware connectivity data.
trans-unit.source: This configures how the data associated with the currently configured display is matched to a detected display during the configuration/detection process. Changing this setting might cause a display to be recognized as previously unconnected and disassociate existing saved display configuration data. System UUID match uses the macOS default identification. When set to use basic identifiers, the app identifies the display by its vendor/model IDs and serial number. With extended it also uses product name, alphanumeric serial number, and production date. With port and location the app also considers hardware connectivity data.
trans-unit.target: Configura com es relacionen les dades de la pantalla configurada actualment amb una pantalla detectada durant el procés de configuració o detecció. Canviar aquest ajust pot fer que una pantalla es reconegui com si no s’hagués connectat mai i desvincular-ne les dades de configuració desades. Coincidència de l’UUID del sistema utilitza la identificació per omissió del macOS. Amb identificadors bàsics, l’app identifica la pantalla pels ID de fabricant i model i el número de sèrie. Amb identificadors ampliats, també utilitza el nom del producte, el número de sèrie alfanumèric i la data de fabricació. Amb port i ubicació, l’app també té en compte les dades de connexió del maquinari.

trans-unit.id: This prevents momentary brightness fluctuations after HDR content was presented on the display. trans-unit.id: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.source: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Quan l’ampliació HDR està activada i el control de brillantor per maquinari està desactivat, l’app utilitza una escala contínua de brillantor entre zero i el valor màxim d’ampliació calibrat. Per això, l’ajust neutre (brillantor del 100⁠%, quan no es retalla el rang del contingut HDR de la pantalla) pot no coincidir amb el límit d’un segment de l’OSD, cosa que dificulta arribar-hi amb les dreceres de teclat. Per corregir-ho, s’insereix un pas addicional dins del segment al 100⁠% de brillantor.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Neutral software HDR brightness keyboard step setting help.

trans-unit.target: Quan hi ha una finestra oberta

trans-unit.source: When this is enabled, the app will use hardware brightness for combined brightness control instead of the SDR peak brightness adjustment control (HDR brightness control) provided by macOS. Encara podeu ajustar la brillantor màxima SDR al Centre de control; aquests ajustos influiran en el marge d’ampliació que proporciona l’app (si està disponible). trans-unit.id: When this is enabled, the app will use the matching audio device's native audio controls (if available) instead of direct hardware control (via DDC or control integration). trans-unit.source: When this is enabled, the app will use the matching audio device's native audio controls (if available) instead of direct hardware control (via DDC or control integration). trans-unit.source:
⚠️ An EDID write operation modifies the EDID and DisplayID data on the device itself. Erroneous EDID data or a problem during EDID write might render the display permanently unusable!

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ For this XDR display it is best to set calibration to Default - Auto Calibrate so the app can automatically adapt upscaling to the currently selected Apple Display Preset and environmental factors. For manual calibration set the brightness slider as high as possible while also making sure you still see the smiling face!
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ For this XDR display it is best to set calibration to Default - Auto Calibrate so the app can automatically adapt upscaling to the currently selected Apple Display Preset and environmental factors. For manual calibration set the brightness slider as high as possible while also making sure you still see the smiling face!
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Per a aquesta pantalla XDR, és millor establir el calibratge a Per omissió - Calibratge automàtic perquè l’app pugui adaptar automàticament l’ampliació de la brillantor al preajust de pantalla d’Apple seleccionat i als factors ambientals. Per al calibratge manual, apugeu el regulador de brillantor tant com sigui possible, tot assegurant-vos que encara veieu la cara somrient!
trans-unit.note: 53477 - XDR brightness upscaling calibration help; the smiling face is a visual calibration target.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ Full screen streaming is unavailable as it requires Screen Recording permissions. You can grant this under System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen Recording!

trans-unit.note: 53477 - Full-screen streaming permission warning pointing to macOS Screen Recording settings.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ If a third party app is being used to show the OSD, you might want to disable the built-in OSD under Keyboard/OSD to avoid having duplicated or mixed-style OSDs presented!

trans-unit.note: 53477 - OSD integration help: disable the built-in on-screen indicator when using a third-party provider.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ If you want to mirror/stream the virtual screen to a natively connected display only to get flexible HiDPI resolutions, it is recommended to use the flexible scaling feature instead if possible! If you want to use mirroring instead of streaming, this can be enabled in the app menu once the virtual screen is connected.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ If you want to mirror/stream the virtual screen to a natively connected display only to get flexible HiDPI resolutions, it is recommended to use the flexible scaling feature instead if possible! If you want to use mirroring instead of streaming, this can be enabled in the app menu once the virtual screen is connected.
trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Si voleu duplicar o transmetre la pantalla virtual a una pantalla connectada nativament només per obtenir resolucions HiDPI flexibles, es recomana utilitzar l’escalat flexible sempre que sigui possible! Si voleu utilitzar la duplicació en lloc de la transmissió, podeu activar-la al menú de l’app un cop connectada la pantalla virtual.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Virtual screen help recommending flexible scaling for native displays when only flexible HiDPI resolutions are needed.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ This setting may prevent DisplayLink displays from showing the overlay effect and, with some DisplayLink driver versions, may lead to increased CPU usage. It also prevents dimming and color adjustments from taking effect in screen streams and PIP windows.
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ This setting may prevent DisplayLink displays from showing the overlay effect and, with some DisplayLink driver versions, may lead to increased CPU usage. It also prevents dimming and color adjustments from taking effect in screen streams and PIP windows.
